'''Clarin Karagan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi Consular|Consular]], Karagan was active in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the years of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] resurgence in the prelude to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Clarin Karagan had passed his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] and attained the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Pursuing independent study as a [[Jedi Consular]], Karagan accepted missions from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] tat took him around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Jedi Karagan attended the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] [[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY|Anniversary celebration]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. Part of a Jedi delegation from the [[Almas Academy|Academy]] of [[Almas]], Karagan and his colleagues ensured a safe environment at the celebration as well as participating in the festivities.<ref name="BA" />
